subject: Account claim validation for SOC2 packet - next steps
messages:
From: CedarRock Security <security@cedarrock.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Vaughan <alex@auditco.io>
Date: 2027-04-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Account ownership snapshot for SOC2 intake

Hi Priya,

Per our SOC2 intake checklist we need a short, itemized bundle showing:
- a snapshot of SCIM deltas (last 30 days) for the CedarRock tenant
- example SAML assertion(s) for admin and service accounts
- an ownership matrix that maps role -> owner (technical and business)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the SCIM delta csv and a redacted SAML assertion sample by EOD tomorrow? Auditor Alex is on the line for any format questions.

Thanks,
Maya (on behalf of CedarRock Security)
Security Operations
CedarRock Health

-----
Attachment request: please include filename stubs and redact where PHI might appear.

From: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
To: CedarRock Security <security@cedarrock.com>
Cc: Alex Vaughan <alex@auditco.io>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Account ownership snapshot for SOC2 intake

Hi Maya / Alex —

We can deliver what you asked. Quick plan:
1) SCIM delta export (CSV) — we will include a delta for the last 30 days scoped to the CedarRock tenant and redact email addresses where needed.
2) SAML assertion sample — redacted assertion showing typical attributes for admin and a service account.
3) Role ownership matrix — XLSX mapping RBAC roles to owner emails and ownership type (technical/business).

Rishi (CC) will run the SCIM extraction and produce the CSV. I will compile the role matrix and Hannah will provide the SAML assertion redaction guidance to ensure no PHI.

Deliverables ETA: 2027-04-22 5pm PT. If you need an earlier drop (partial SCIM first) let me know and we can send the CSV in the morning.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-21T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Account ownership snapshot for SOC2 intake

Team — quick ops notes while I kick off the export:
- SCIM extraction will pull 30 days of user and group deltas from the tenant's provisioning logs. I will strip PII columns (email -> <redacted>) and provide a column mapping file.
- For service accounts we will include service_account:true flag and the last_active timestamp.
- I'll attach the raw export and the redacted CSV as separate files; CedarRock can request the raw if they want hashed identifiers for verification.

Hannah — can you add the expected SAML attributes we should redact (NameID, email, group membership)? I will scope the export to avoid PHI.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

-----
Attachment stubs: scim_delta_raw_20270421.csv (raw export), scim_delta_snapshot.csv (redacted)

From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, CedarRock Security <security@cedarrock.com>, Alex Vaughan <alex@auditco.io>
Date: 2027-04-22T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Account ownership snapshot for SOC2 intake

Thanks all — output bundle attached (see stubs below). Notes for the auditor:
- saml-assertion-sample.txt contains two redacted assertions: one for an admin principal and one for a service principal. We stripped NameID and any claim that could contain PHI, replaced user emails with userX@redacted.local, and left attribute names intact so you can validate mapping.
- role-ownership-matrix.xlsx includes an "owner_type" column (technical/business) and a "last_reviewed" timestamp; owners are Redwood staff contacts, not customer contacts.
- scim_delta_snapshot.csv shows additions/updates/deletes; we included a trace_id column for cross-referencing with your audit logs.

If Alex needs a different file format or a signed hash of the raw export for chain-of-custody, say the word and we'll get it out.

Hannah Schmitt
Security & Controls Lead
Redwood Inference

-----
Attachments: scim_delta_snapshot.csv, saml-assertion-sample.txt, role-ownership-matrix.xlsx
